bbs.config.pov.title: POV
bbs.config.pov.tooltip: Options related to First Person POV
bbs.config.pov.toggle_all-comment: Enable or disable all POV baking options at once.
bbs.config.pov.bake_actions-comment: Record GUI actions, screens, menus, toasts, and status effects into replay clips.
bbs.config.pov.bake_camera_shake-comment: Record vanilla hurt-camera motion into Camera Shake action clips.
bbs.config.pov.bake_particles-comment: Record on-screen vanilla particles into Particle Effect clips.
bbs.config.pov.bake_boss_bars-comment: Record boss bars into Boss Bar action clips.

bbs.config.pov.cursor_texture-comment: Image used for the GUI cursor.
bbs.config.pov.cursor_crop-comment: Visible area of the cursor image.
